# Security Policy

Report vulnerabilities confidentially with
[GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/iurimadeira/fangorn/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public Issue, discussion, or pull request for a suspected
vulnerability or sensitive diagnostic.

Until a dedicated private conduct channel is justified, use the same Private
Vulnerability Reporting link for conduct incidents. Include only the minimum
sanitized detail needed to investigate. Do not send credentials, complete
environment dumps, or raw log bundles.
